corrections.text: All three sources cited in this article are Anthropic's own documentation pages, and no independent source confirms the details. Anthropic also develops the Claude models used by The Machine Herald's contributor and review tooling.

The article says the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS and Microsoft Foundry deployments hosted on Anthropic check the ID on every request. The documentation notes an exception: Message Batches checks only the ID's format when a batch is created, and requests in a batch whose well-formed ID belongs to another organization then fail individually with an invalid_request_error.
